scope: Procedural playable addition; user approved the runtime and explicitly requested GitHub Casa3D publication on 2026-10-20. No paid generation or Blender export.
reference: User-provided roller-coaster photograph: two blue rails, transverse sleepers, broad banked curves, first-person travel.
function: Click/tap any parked car or use E, confirm boarding, then ride around the house, through space and through two connected lakes. Dismount is automatic only at the end.
placement: Right of the initial landing, ahead of the player, with a front-facing boarding sign.

recovery: Normal completion returns to the side platform with upright body and walking controls. No in-ride dismount. Held props are hidden during riding and restored afterwards; mug starts unequipped and reuses lollipop pickup/inventory methods.
symmetry: Rail pair and sleepers symmetric about the centreline; route intentionally asymmetric to avoid existing content.

budgets.underwater: Shared geometries in a dedicated render scene

spaceStructureException: Free-floating rail spans in space are intentional game architecture.
